description: "Siphon the vigor from your enemies' blood, dealing |cffffff6401|r Disease Damage to all nearby enemies.\n\nIf an enemy is hit you gain Major Brutality and Sorcery, and Minor Courage increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r% and |cffffff215|r for |cffffff30|r seconds.
